purpose.zh: 练肩前侧和手腕，团身俄挺前的一级（初级前倾）
purpose.en: Trains the front of your shoulders and wrists; the step before the tuck planche (beginner lean).

text.zh: 手臂锁直，肩膀往前移过手腕
text.en: Arms locked, shift your shoulders past your wrists

text.zh: 脚尖踩住垫子往前滚，整个人一起往前走，先过手腕一个拳头左右就够了。
text.en: Roll forward over your toes and move as one piece; about a fist past your wrists is plenty to start.

text.zh: 肩胛骨把地推开、往下压，别让肩膀往耳朵那边耸。
text.en: Push the floor away and press your shoulders down, away from your ears.

text.zh: 屁股微微往里收，从头到脚跟一条线，手指往外转一点手腕更舒服。
text.en: Tuck your tailbone a little, head to heels in one line; turning your fingers out eases your wrists.

commonErrors.en: Sagging your lower back or piking your hips.

commonErrors.zh: 肩胛骨夹紧，没把地面推开
commonErrors.en: Squeezing your shoulder blades instead of pushing the floor away.

cautions.zh: 手腕吃不住就少往前一点，从过手腕 5 厘米开始
cautions.en: If your wrists can't take it, lean less and start about 5 cm past your wrists.

thomasSupplement.camera: 正侧面（清楚显示肩超过手腕多少）
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief. r2 animation is the beginner lean: shoulders about 11 cm past the wrists, held about 4 s, arms locked, shoulder blades pushed apart and down.

set.zh: 手臂锁直，把地推开，肩往下压
set.en: Arms locked, push the floor, shoulders down
